question: When does consciousness-bliss arise in its unconditioned fullness?
premises: One may attain a rest that is unconditioned and utterly full.
Consciousness-bliss is not nourished by the inert.
Such rest corresponds to that consciousness-bliss.
inference: Therefore when unconditioned and utterly full rest is attained, consciousness-bliss arises, independent of the inert.
plain_english: When one attains a rest that is unconditioned and utterly full, then indeed there is consciousness-bliss, which is not nourished by anything inert.
